name: HemoDinks - Saude da producao
description: Versionado em observability/newrelic (#289). Nao edite pela interface: a proxima aplicacao sobrescreve.

widgets.title: Requisicoes por minuto
widgets.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = '{{APM_APP}}' AND request.uri NOT IN ('/livez', '/healthz', '/alive', '/health') TIMESERIES SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Taxa de 5xx (%)
widgets.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE httpResponseCode >= 500) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = '{{APM_APP}}' AND request.uri NOT IN ('/livez', '/healthz', '/alive', '/health') TIMESERIES SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: 503 de banco indisponivel
widgets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = '{{APM_APP}}' AND httpResponseCode = 503 TIMESERIES SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Login - p95 (s)
widgets.query: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = '{{APM_APP}}' AND request.uri IN ('/api/users/authenticate', '/api/users/login-context', '/api/session/renovar', '/api/session/restaurar') TIMESERIES SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Rotas criticas - p95 por transacao (s)
widgets.query: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = '{{APM_APP}}' AND (request.uri LIKE '/api/pacientes%' OR request.uri LIKE '/api/events%' OR request.uri LIKE '/api/faturamentos%') FACET name SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Erros por classe
widgets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = '{{APM_APP}}' FACET error.class SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Usuarios online (snapshot)
widgets.query: SELECT max(numeric(UsuariosOnline)) AS 'Usuarios online', max(numeric(TotalSessoes)) AS 'Sessoes' FROM Log WHERE entity.name = '{{APM_APP}}' AND message LIKE 'ActiveSessionsSnapshot %' TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Erros JavaScript
widgets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM JavaScriptError WHERE appName = '{{BROWSER_APP}}' TIMESERIES SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Erros JavaScript por classe
widgets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM JavaScriptError WHERE appName = '{{BROWSER_APP}}' FACET errorClass SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 10
